intro h
apply le_antisymm
· have : f '' (f '' s) ⊆ s := by
    intro x
    intro hx
    cases hx with y hy
    exact hf y
· have : s ⊆ f '' (f '' s) := by
    intro x
    intro hx
    use (f x)
    refine ⟨_, _⟩
    · rw [image_eq]
      exact ⟨x, hx⟩
    · rw [image_eq]
      exact ⟨f x, rfl⟩
